dump.noSerials: This DAT has no game IDs, so bad dumps show as unknown. Redump’s “serial, version” DAT has them.
dump.datHint: Redump is asked only when you press the button, and at most once a week. A DAT downloaded by hand (.dat or Redump’s .zip) can be imported instead.

update.tooSoon: Redump was asked less than a week ago; it can be asked again after {{date}}.

dump.browseDescription: A .dat file or Redump’s .zip, inside the folders the server was started with.

convert.description: The new image is written first; the old one is deleted only once the new one is complete. Game IDs, settings, art and cheats stay as they are.

hints.iso: A plain image: every OPL version reads it; takes the most space.
hints.zso: Compressed with LZ4: smaller; OPL 1.2.0 beta and newer read it. A few games load more slowly.
hints.ul: 1 GiB parts listed in ul.cfg: for old loaders, or for FAT32 with games over 4 GiB. Titles are cut to 32 characters.

convert.deleteNote: The plan lists every file; deleting the old images needs your confirmation.

reasons.appBadBoot: boot must be a plain ELF file name, not {{boot}}
reasons.binEndsEarly: the BIN ends before its data track does
reasons.binMissing: the BIN named in the sheet ({{file}}) is missing
reasons.binNoVolume: a BIN without a CUE sheet, and no ISO 9660 volume in it
reasons.binPartialSector: the track is {{length}} bytes from sector {{start}}, not a whole number of {{size}}-byte sectors
reasons.chdBadMetadata: the CD track metadata cannot be read: {{error}}
reasons.chdInArchive: a CHD inside an archive is not read: unpack the CHD first (it is compressed already)
reasons.chdLayout: a CHD of {{unit}}-byte units is neither a CD nor a DVD
reasons.chdNeedsParent: this CHD needs a parent CHD; merge it first (chdman copy)
reasons.chtBlankName: line {{line}} renames the next cheat to blanks
reasons.chtCodesWithoutName: codes before the first name are dropped ({{codes}})
reasons.chtTooManyCheats: more than 250 cheats: OPL writes past its array
reasons.cnfEof: SYSTEM.CNF ends inside the BOOT2 line
reasons.cnfNoColon: the BOOT2 value has no device prefix such as cdrom0:
reasons.cnfNoFile: the BOOT2 value names no file
reasons.cnfNulByte: SYSTEM.CNF has a NUL byte before its BOOT2 line
reasons.cnfTooLong: the BOOT2 value is too long for OPL’s 64-byte buffer
reasons.cueFileType: FILE type {{type}} is not supported; only BINARY
reasons.cueNoFile: the CUE sheet names no FILE
reasons.cueNoTrack: the CUE sheet names no TRACK
reasons.cueTrackNoEnd: track {{track}} has no INDEX, so the data track has no end
reasons.cueTrackOrder: track {{track}} starts before the data track does
reasons.isoUnreadable: the ISO 9660 file system cannot be read: {{error}}
reasons.noBoot2: SYSTEM.CNF has no BOOT2 line (a PS1 disc, a video DVD or a damaged image)
reasons.noChdSupport: this build of YAOPLM reads no CHD images
reasons.noSystemCnf: there is no SYSTEM.CNF;1 in the root directory (OPL needs exactly this name)
reasons.recordNonAsciiName: the title has non-ASCII bytes; OPL hashes them unpredictably
reasons.recordUnknownMedia: media byte {{value}} is neither CD nor DVD; OPL shows it as DVD
reasons.secondDataTrack: track {{track}} is a second data track (a mixed-mode or CD-Extra disc)
reasons.trackNotData: track mode {{mode}} holds no PS2 data
reasons.vmcBadMagic: not a PS2 memory card image (no superblock magic)
reasons.vmcCardType: card type {{type}} is not a PS2 card (2)
reasons.vmcNotWholeMib: the size {{size}} is not a whole number of MiB
reasons.vmcSizeMismatch: the file is {{file}} bytes but the superblock describes {{card}}
reasons.zsoBlockSize: the block size is {{size}}; OPL only reads 2048-byte blocks
reasons.zsoPartialBlock: the uncompressed size {{size}} is not a multiple of 2048; the tail is unreadable
reasons.compatibilityBits: modes {{value}} include bits this loader does not know (allowed {{allowed}})
reasons.altStartupTooLong: the alternative startup {{value}} is too long (at most {{max}} characters)
reasons.altStartupChars: the alternative startup {{value}} is not a file name on the disc (only letters, digits, underscores, dots, hyphens and backslashes)
reasons.gsmVmode: GSM video mode {{value}} is not one of OPL’s 0 to {{max}}
reasons.gsmOffset: GSM shift {{value}} is outside what OPL’s menu allows (−{{max}} to {{max}})
reasons.cfgKeyTooLong: key {{key}} is too long (at most {{max}} characters)
reasons.cfgKeyChars: key {{key}} has a character OPL cannot store (=, a line break or a leading space)
reasons.cfgRuntimeKey: key {{key}} starts with #: OPL never saves such keys
reasons.cfgValueTooLong: the value of {{key}} is too long ({{length}} bytes; OPL keeps {{max}})
reasons.cfgValueChars: the value of {{key}} has a line break or NUL
reasons.vmcNameChars: {{name}} has characters outside ASCII or ones a file name cannot hold
reasons.profileByElfVersion: {{loader}} {{version}} at {{path}}, by the version inside the file
reasons.profileByOpl110Keys: {{file}} has none of the keys OPL 1.2 always writes
reasons.profileByOldGamesBin: {{file}} was last written by OPL 1.1.0 or a beta up to build 2016
reasons.profileByNewGamesBin: {{file}} was last written by a beta from build 2017 on or a fork of OPL 1.2
reasons.profileByExfat: the device is exFAT, which OPL 1.1.0 cannot read
reasons.profileByZso: ZSO images ({{images}}), which OPL 1.1.0 does not show
reasons.profileNoSigns: no signs of a loader on the device
reasons.profileByCopy: {{reason}} (a copy: over SMB the console starts OPL from a memory card or stick)
reasons.placeUsbDisk: a USB disk with {{fs}}: the console reads it only over the network
reasons.placeUsbDiskOther: a USB disk OPL cannot read over USB: the console reads it only over the network
reasons.placeComputerDisk: a folder on the computer’s disk
reasons.placeEmulator: the files of a memory card emulator: {{files}}
reasons.profileByBootCard: {{version}} with MMCE in {{file}} inside boot card {{channel}} ({{variant}})

cfg.heading: Game settings
cfg.libconfig: {{path}} is in wOPL’s libconfig format: YAOPLM shows it but does not change it.
cfg.modesHint: Turn a mode on only when the game does not start, freezes or shows glitches; the OPL compatibility list says which one helps.

modeHints.1: Reads at the speed and in the way of the console’s drive
modeHints.2: Another way of reading data, synchronously
modeHints.4: Takes OPL’s hooks off the system calls
modeHints.8: Skips the game’s PSS and Bink videos
modeHints.16: For DVD-9 images whose two layers were joined into one
modeHints.32: Turns off the button combination that returns to OPL during play
modeHints.64: Neutrino only: fixes a game buffer overrun
modeHints.128: Reads a DVD as slowly as a CD

cfg.otherBits: The CFG also sets bits {{bits}}, which this loader does not use; they stay as they are.
cfg.noCard: None: the memory card in the slot
cfg.cardExists: {{name}} is already on the device: choose it in the list.
cfg.newCardDescription: A blank card formatted the way OPL formats it. It is written when the plan is confirmed.
cfg.cardNameHint: VMC/<name>.bin, up to 31 Latin characters. OPL suggests <ID>_0 and <ID>_1; generic_0 and generic_1 are shared by several games.
cfg.cardNameInvalid: Latin letters, digits and signs only, without */:<>?\| and quotes.
cfg.replaceCard: Replace {{name}} with a blank card. The old one, with its saves, moves to the .yaoplm/backup folder on the device.
cfg.offsetRange: OPL’s menu shifts the picture by −{{max}} to {{max}}.
cfg.gsmFieldFixHint: For games that glitch in progressive video modes
cfg.padEmuHint: A DualShock 3 or 4 over USB or Bluetooth in place of a PS2 pad
cfg.altStartupHint: An ELF on the disc to boot instead of the one in SYSTEM.CNF, such as SLUS_200.63; up to {{max}} characters, without ;1. Empty: as usual.
cfg.notThereYet: {{path}} (not there yet: OPL uses its defaults)
cfg.cardReplacing: {{name}} (a new {{size}} MiB card in its place)
